args.reason: Offline same-provider-family calibration only, without provider independence or production eligibility. The PRD expressly excludes historical storage and query features. The proposed history JSONL log, full timeline, --explain, --since and output formats implement precisely those excluded capabilities. A warranted dry-run flag does not warrant these added DoD obligations. Phase 1 incorrectly expands current inspection into historical querying; the proposal exceeds declared goals.
